_about: Manual-entry fields no API publishes (SPEC section 2): data_residency, data_retention, deprecation_date, per catalog model. Each is a SPEC section 2 figure (value, unit, source_id, collection_date), or a gap with the reason and the page checked. A gap is never filled in: it scores 0 if weighted and excludes with missing_data:<field> if hard.
_rule: Residency and retention describe the vendor's first-party API; an open-weight model with no first-party API is a gap (team, 2026-10-28). deprecation_date is the announced earliest retirement date.
